resources.string: Bring in your watch, phone and scale
Kal reads these from Health Connect. You choose which ones on the next screen; you can change it later.
Type, time and energy, for Move and water
When you slept and for how long
Weigh-ins from Renpho or Samsung Health, for Body
Also send in the background, about once an hour
Sending in the background needs a newer Health Connect on this phone. Kal sends while its Health Connect screen is open.
Sent only to your Kal server. Kal never writes to Health Connect.
Kal may read nothing yet. Choose at least one kind of record.
Open Kal, then More, Kal for Android, and tap Connect Health Connect.
Health Connect needs Android 9 or newer. On this phone Kal works without it: everything else is the same.
Health Connect is not on this phone yet. Install it from the Play Store, then come back.
Health Connect needs an update. Update it from the Play Store, then come back.
Without background access, Kal sends only while this screen is open. Samsung Health and the Renpho app must also be set to share with Health Connect.
Samsung Health and the Renpho app must also be set to share with Health Connect.

Kal reads the records you allowed and sends them to your own Kal server, where only you can see them. They feed Move, water and Body. Nothing is sold, shared or sent to an AI. Removing your Kal data deletes them on the server too.
This screen is also what Android shows from Health Connect\'s “privacy policy” link.
Kal stops sending from this phone. Your records already on the server stay.
Kal %1$s is ready. Download it from your Kal server to update.
Not sent: no connection to your Kal server. Kal tries again later.
Not sent: your Kal server answered with an error. Kal tries again later.
Not sent: Health Connect did not allow reading. Check the access below.
Version %1$s. Tap to download it from your Kal server.
